<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2162040_documate.AutomationRunner</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AutomationRunner</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AutomationRunner = Class.create();
AutomationRunner.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /*
     * Called by generated Business Rule.
     */
    runForRecordChange: function(templateSysId, record) {
        var template = new GlideRecord('x_2162040_documate_templates');

        if (!template.get(templateSysId)) {
            return;
        }

        if (template.getValue('state') != 'published') {
            return;
        }

        var engine = new x_2162040_documate.CoreEngine();

        if (!engine.evaluateCondition(template, record)) {
            new x_2162040_documate.instanceUtils().createSkipped(
                template,
                record,
                'Template condition did not match.'
            );
            return;
        }

        engine.generateDocument(template, record);
    },

    /*
     * Called by generated Scheduled Job.
     *
     * First simple version:
     * - loads template
     * - queries template.table
     * - applies schedule_condition if field exists and has value
     * - generates document for matching records
     */
    runScheduled: function(templateSysId) {
        var template = new GlideRecord('x_2162040_documate_templates');

        if (!template.get(templateSysId)) {
            return;
        }

        if (template.getValue('state') != 'published') {
            return;
        }

        var tableName = template.getValue('table');

        if (!tableName) {
            return;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord(tableName);

        if (!gr.isValid()) {
            return;
        }

        if (template.isValidField('schedule_condition')) {
            var scheduleCondition = template.getValue('schedule_condition');

            if (scheduleCondition) {
                gr.addEncodedQuery(scheduleCondition);
            }
        }

        gr.query();

        var engine = new x_2162040_documate.CoreEngine();

        while (gr.next()) {
            if (engine.evaluateCondition(template, gr)) {
                engine.generateDocument(template, gr);
            } else {
                new x_2162040_documate.instanceUtils().createSkipped(
                    template,
                    gr,
                    'Template condition did not match.'
                );
            }
        }
    },

    type: 'AutomationRunner'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-08 10:29:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>2d45736bc394131076cbbecdd4013161</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AutomationRunner</sys_name><sys_package display_value="DocuMate" source="x_2162040_documate">0b329140c358971076cbbecdd4013131</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="DocuMate">0b329140c358971076cbbecdd4013131</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2d45736bc394131076cbbecdd4013161</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-08 10:29:44</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
